_about: Single source of truth for which pages are offered to search engines and ad review. Pages listed in noindexPaths stay live for visitors (nothing 404s), but they get <meta name=robots content='noindex, follow'>, are left out of sitemap.xml, and are dropped from the header, footer and homepage link lists. To publish a page again, delete its entry, add its URL back to public/sitemap.xml, and restore its nav link. The prerender build fails if sitemap.xml lists a page this file withholds. Added 2026-11-25 after the AdSense 'Low value content' rejection.
_publishLocalizedPagesWhy: Kept true on 2026-11-25 by the owner's decision: Search Console showed /es/video-to-frames rising from 2 to 13 clicks a week (position 8.4) and other Spanish and Arabic pages gaining. Known risk: the localized bodies are still mostly English, which matches Google's scaled-content pattern. Setting this to false withholds every /es, /fr, /de, /pt, /zh, /ar and /hi URL (noindex, no hreflang); the sitemap must then drop those URLs and their xhtml:link alternates or the build fails.

noindexPaths.reason: Downloads other creators' thumbnail artwork from YouTube's servers; a poor fit for an ads-supported site under review. Already pulled from the footer on 2026-10-29.
